description: Add Club Creation with President Assignment and Club President Powers. When creating a club, require president's Telegram ID. Club president can ONLY create/manage events for their own club.
steps: STEP 1 - Update club creation FSM in bot/handlers/admin.py: (a) Add new state to ClubState: waiting_for_president_id. (b) After entering club name, ask for president's Telegram ID. (c) In the president ID handler: validate that the user exists in the system (get_user_by_tg_id), create the club, then set that user's role to PRESIDENT, set their club_id to the new club, and set club.president_id to that user's id. (d) Update create_club() in crud.py to accept president_tg_id parameter.

STEP 2 - Enforce club president restrictions in bot/handlers/admin.py: (a) In add_event_start (add_new_event callback): For PRESIDENT role, auto-set club_id from their own club. Store it in FSM state. (b) In the final event creation step: If the creator is PRESIDENT, always use their club_id regardless of what create_event would default to. (c) In manage_specific_event: The existing check_admin with club_id_needed already partially enforces this. Verify it works correctly for PRESIDENT users - they should only see/manage events where event.club_id == their club_id.

STEP 3 - Add club president event management: (a) In bot/handlers/admin.py, add a handler for PRESIDENT to edit their club's events. Add new FSM states: EditEventState with waiting_for_event_id, waiting_for_field, waiting_for_value. (b) President can change: title, description, post_link, registration_points, attendance_points, status (ACTIVE/COMPLETED/CANCELLED), check_in_enabled. (c) Add /edit_event command accessible to VP, PRESIDENT, SUPER_ADMIN. The handler should show only events belonging to the user's club (for PRESIDENT/VP) or all events (for SUPER_ADMIN).

STEP 4 - Update CRUD for club-scoped operations: (a) In crud.py add get_events_by_club(club_id) function. (b) Add update_event_field(event_id, field_name, value) function for editing individual fields. (c) Update create_club() to accept and process president_tg_id: create club, find user by tg_id, set user.role=PRESIDENT, user.club_id=club.id, club.president_id=user.id.

STEP 5 - Filter event display for presidents: In show_admin_panel() ('Klub Boshqaruvi' handler): If user is PRESIDENT or VP, only show events for their club_id. Use get_events_by_club() instead of get_active_events(). SUPER_ADMIN sees all events.
acceptance_criteria: Club creation asks for president Telegram ID and assigns the role
President user gets PRESIDENT role and is linked to the club
Club president can only create events under their own club
Club president can only see/manage events of their own club in 'Klub Boshqaruvi'
Club president can edit their club's event fields
Super admin can still create events for any club and manage all events
get_events_by_club() function exists and works correctly
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/bott/UFQ_EVENT_BOT_FINAL && python -m py_compile bot/handlers/admin.py && echo OK
Run: python -m py_compile bot/database/crud.py && echo OK
Run: python -c "from bot.database.crud import get_events_by_club, create_club; print('Imports OK')"
Run: python -c "from bot.handlers.admin import ClubState; assert hasattr(ClubState, 'waiting_for_president_id'); print('PASS')"
